sn_aia_tool.description: Looks up either a consumer or a contact by phone number using the platform Flow Action. When found, retrieves customer profile details, financial accounts (checking, savings, credit cards, loans), current open cases, the business account they are calling from (if a contact), and all customer-visible open tasks on those cases.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"phone_number","description":"The customer phone number in E.164 or standard telephone format (e.g. +14374521482)","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
